notes.title: Happy Third Exoversary!
notes.content:
[p]🍄🚀 I Was a Teenage Exocolonist 🍄🚀 has been everyone's favorite solarpunk time loop stats-raising coming of age narrative/sim game for [b]three years[/b]! As is tradition, we're celebrating our Exoversary with a half price sale, a free demo, a dev stream, and our biggest ever (physically big that is) [url="https://www.makeship.com/shop/creator/northway-games"]plushie campaign[/url]![/p][p][/p][h3]🎨🎙️ Developer draw & talk[/h3][p]Join us on Thursday, August 28 at 9am PT / 12pm ET on the [url="https://www.twitch.tv/finjico"]Finji Twitch Stream[/url] for chatting and doodles with devs Sarah, Mei, Lindsay, and our host Aster from Finji. There will be giveaways!![/p][p][/p][h3]🛒🕹️Sale and demo[/h3][p]⁠The Exocolonist demo features the full first year of the game, and if you want to keep playing you can continue smoothly into the rest of the game with a 50% discount this week![/p][p] [/p][h3]👾🧸Faceless and friends[/h3][p]We're doing another limited time plushie campaign with [url="https://www.makeship.com/shop/creator/northway-games"]Makeship[/url]! This time for a jumbo-sized faceless plushie that comes with two mini accessory sized dolls of Dys and Sym![/p][p]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/d341693ed5fad8638a4794b054bda45330298701.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Yes I lied before when I said we wouldn't make any more! Who could resist taking that big squiggly wiggly stompy baddie and turning her into the cutest eldritch puppy dog? Just look at that face! (what face?)[/p][p][/p][h1]✨[url="https://www.makeship.com/shop/creator/northway-games"]Get yours before September 16th[/url]✨[/h1][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/39715054bbbf71a4e4257025129f867a0e5aab51.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Limited time only campaign[/h3][p]This time we have [b]three weeks[/b] to get a minimum of 200 orders. On September 16 the campaign ends, and if we've met our goal then every plushie will be made-to-order for our backers and delivered in December. After that, no more will be made! There's a special bonus for the first 200 orders which will be delivered at the end of September.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/05dd3b76fe4864070ff780f2303bee70b0deaed9.jpg"][/img][/p][p](Sol doll for scale)[/p][p][/p][h3]She's big![/h3][p]This faceless plush is jumbo sized, quite a bit bigger than our previous Makeship dolls. And Dys and Sym are keychain sized little fellers that tuck snuggly into those squiggly wigglers (you can tell at least Sym enjoys it). It would be pretty easy to [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8bN4Z78A4lw&t=447s"]actually turn them into purse charms[/url] if you're crafty.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/40d76a3192d82d2bfa25e4109db1abb70fec35ff.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]✨[url="https://www.makeship.com/shop/creator/northway-games"]Get yours before September 16th[/url]✨[/h1][p][/p][p]Happy Exoversary! Come [url="https://discord.com/invite/finji"]join us on Discord[/url] to celebrate with the devs!

- Sarah ːexosmileː[/p]

notes.title: Fan Merch and Mods
notes.content:
Not only has the I Was a Teenage Exocolonist fandom kept the story going with fic (336 works and counting on [url=https://archiveofourown.org/tags/I%20Was%20a%20Teenage%20Exocolonist%20(Video%20Game)/works]AO3[/url]), they’ve been busy modding the game and making rad fan merch. Northway Games has always [url=https://northwaygames.com/contact/]granted permission[/url] for anyone to sell fan merch of our games using their own original art. It feels so amazing to have a piece of Exocolonist fandom hanging from my bag or dangling from my ears, out here in the real world.

So here’s a showcase! [i](this is a repost from the [url=https://northwaygames.com/]Northway Games blog[/url] which is so popular it got 4500 spam comments last month when I accidentally broke the recaptcha)[/i]

[h1]Official-ish Merch from Mei[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/ff08cae73b9dbcfb24fe39c062c3d8814874140d.jpg[/img]
[i][url=https://bkomei.bigcartel.com/]Mei’s wooden charms[/url][/i]

Exocolonist artist Mei ([url=https://bsky.app/profile/bkomei.bsky.social]@bkomei[/url]) just announced preorders for the [url=https://bkomei.bigcartel.com/]cuuuuuuuutest wooden character charms[/url], with unique shapes and different pictures on the two sides. They’re so slick! I love that they’re in a different chibi style than Mei used in the game, but they still give 100% Exocolonist vibes.

Preorder them here: [url=https://bkomei.bigcartel.com/]https://bkomei.bigcartel.com[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/67476171659acf563ed90e881cb6bc5c5b720cf2.gif[/img]

Mei’s also selling several prints of their in-game illustrations, and making these cool interactive CD jewel case charms that are just beautiful and all kinds of nostalgic. These will be a limited run so get one while you can!


[h1]Official-ish Merch from Lindsay[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/7c314e3ff68e111d7993f92c73bdb679a47feb4f.jpg[/img]
[i][url=https://www.inprnt.com/frames/neomeruru]Glow Season by Lindsay Ishihiro[/url] (on my wall o stuff)[/i]

Exocolonist writer/artist Lindsay also has semi-official prints available on Inprnt. I love this one of the gang telling stories around a campfire, the colors are sooooo purdy. There are also prints available of Lindsay’s creature art from in the game.

All here: [url=https://www.inprnt.com/frames/neomeruru]https://www.inprnt.com/frames/neomeruru[/url]

[h1]Poayo’s Etsy Empire[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/d2194b8a3276172dbf717a99ec390377f0098617.jpg[/img]
[i]Poayo’s shop recently added [url=https://www.etsy.com/ca/listing/1852002489/begonia-flora-i-was-a-teenage]keychains[/url] from guest artist Begonia[/i]

With everything from stickers to acrylic standees to body pillows, [url=https://poayosuniverse.etsy.com/]Poayo’s Etsy shop[/url] covers a lot of ground featuring their own fanart style. They regularly post new goodies on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Exocolonist/]r/Exocolonist[/url] ([url=https://www.reddit.com/u/poayo_/s/Tok2lttZQq]Reddit profile[/url]) and the [url=https://discord.gg/hgsmfQ4zgJ]Seraphic Discord[/url], so keep an eye there to snag the new-and-hots before they sell out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/1dd1d0b97aa0891ab22e030ffe1df9dd366dd6f7.jpg[/img]
[i]Yes even [url=https://www.etsy.com/ca/listing/1744321500/i-was-a-teenage-exocolonist-body-pillow]body pillows[/url] I wasn’t kidding[/i]

I’ve come across a [url=https://www.etsy.com/ca/listing/1798655978/symbiosis-i-was-a-teenage-exocolonist]few[/url] [url=https://www.redbubble.com/people/3uryd1ce/shop]other[/url] online stores with Exo merch out there, but let’s move on to one of my favorite fan creations:

[h1]The ExtraColonist Mod[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/c57701e33ce636b04d2a00aae93ec78d6c318ee4.png[/img]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/iwasateenageexocolonist/mods/5/]Available on NexusMods.[/url]

This overhaul of the first year of the game introduces a bunch of new characters, even animated and on the map. New storylines, locations, backgrounds, cutscenes, activities, items. It’s really a LOT more than you imagine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/916484ac2660e8da37ab60a6fbe267582d9018b6.gif[/img]

They’re calling it a beta and I hope we get to see more, but in its current state ExtraColonist is absolutely worth playing once you reach the end of the official content and want more. It’s easy to install and jump into with a fresh game (you can keep your groundhogs/past memories). Team Seraphic ([url=https://www.patreon.com/teamseraphicofficial]Patreon / tip jar here[/url]) has done an amazing job. What an absolute labor of love.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/353a1f309b4d6b31dfbfbea8695eea1307c5485e.jpg[/img]
[i]New scenes with characters old and new[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/422ba5b9d6d186417a62e8b3b044b35252a0e68b.jpg[/img]
[i]I love this kid[/i]

Download it from Nexus Mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/iwasateenageexocolonist/mods/5/]https://www.nexusmods.com/iwasateenageexocolonist/mods/5/[/url]
Team Seraphic socials: [url=https://seraphic.ju.mp]https://seraphic.ju.mp[/url]
Poayo is part of the team and sells ExtraColonist merch too: [url=https://poayosuniverse.etsy.com]https://poayosuniverse.etsy.com[/url]

[h1]Official-official Merch[/h1]

The [url=http://shop.finji.co/]Finji Store[/url] still has pinnies, stickers, tees and hawaiian shirts available. We’re selling a physical card game at cost via [url=https://www.thegamecrafter.com/games/i-was-a-teenage-exocolonist]Gamecrafters[/url]. And you’ve seen my posts for [url=https://northwaygames.com/beautiful-ugly-xmas-sweaters/]print-on-demand xmas sweaters[/url] and [url=https://northwaygames.com/exocolonist-merch/]other clothes[/url].

We’ve done five plushies through [url=https://www.makeship.com/shop/creator/northway-games]Makeship [/url]and although these are one-off productions, I have a few squirreled away under the bed (literally) for some future giveaway. Makeship has also been bugging me to do another doll so you never know… join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/finji]Official Discord[/url] or follow Exocolonist on Steam to hear more!

- Sarah ːnyaaː

notes.title: SimFest 2024
notes.content:
Simulation games are my favorite genre. Debatably, the way I play some RPGs and strategy games by ignoring main quests or playing in sandbox mode probably makes them sim games too. Hold on, could EVERYTHING be a sim game? I mean they're all simulating something, right?

Let's back it up. I just reinstalled the Sims 4, arguably King of Sims, which is ten years old and still in the top 30 [url=https://steamcharts.com/top/p.2]most played games on Steam[/url]. I never played with dolls as a kid but hoo boy watching these poor creatures slapfighting and peeing themselves in public never gets old.

Despite I Was a Teenage Exocolonist not simulating bladder-fullness, I still hope people get a similar joy from guiding Sol/Solane/Solanaceae through all the many possibilities of adolescence on Vertumna.

Oh, right, and the game is on sale, with a limited time demo, for SimFest 2024 from July 22-29!

- Sarah ːnyaaː

notes.title: Deckbuilders Fest and Physical Cards
notes.content:
For one week only, the demo is live and game is on sale as we celebrate [url=https://steamgames.com/]the best of deckbuilders on Steam[/url]! I LOVE deck building games. Some of my recent favorites (all roguelikes):

🛸[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179850/Cobalt_Core/]Cobalt Core[/url]
🗡️[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1092790/Inscryption/]Inscryption[/url]
🚂[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1102190/Monster_Train/]Monster Train[/url]
🐉[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/557410/Dream_Quest/]Dream Quest[/url] (obscure but essential)
🃏[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2379780/Balatro/]Balatro[/url] (current obsession)

But there will always be a special place in my heart (and a not insignificant part of my brain) for Magic the Gathering. It's been years since I've [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141910/Magic_The_Gathering_Arena/#app_reviews_hash]played online[/url], but I have an unopened box of Lord of the Rings in my closet just waiting to be drafted. Something about the feel - and that [i]smell[/i] - of glue and cardboard.

So naturally when I was designing the deckbuilding component for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148760/I_Was_a_Teenage_Exocolonist/]I Was a Teenage Exocolonist[/url], I was already thinking about how to make a physical game out of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/04a6f2d658a5eed1b9b0d9fb6a5896e152f8ea46.jpg[/img]

Behold: you can buy it from [url=https://www.thegamecrafter.com/games/i-was-a-teenage-exocolonist]TheGameCrafter.com[/url] for $14.99 USD!

These are made to order (so it might take a while to ship) and feature 52 UV-coated cards in a cute mint tin, with card art from the game. I originally designed them as promotional merch so I'm selling these at cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/a7ae6348c1c100cf15508d6acb67c58c0ef9f856.jpg[/img]

And yes it includes instructions for a playable 1-person game, a simplified version of the minigame in Exocolonist. Shuffle and draw 7 cards, then play a hand of 5 which scores at least 3 points to win the round. Points come from straights, flushes, pairs, or total score, and yes, order matters.

Or screw playing the game, just enjoy the feel of your favorite Exocolonist cards right in your hands. Breathe deeply and smell that hot ink and glue. [url=https://www.thegamecrafter.com/games/i-was-a-teenage-exocolonist]Ahhhhhh[/url].

- Sarah ːcccatː

notes.title: Patch #4 (minor update)
notes.content:
I am still chasing that sweet green checkbox for being fully verified on Steam Deck. Although those in the know can tell you it plays beautifully on there already, there are some sync issues that could make it annoying to switch between deck and PC and downgrade us to only "playable".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/b47d117833222d4791cbc6ddff6bb3b5618ae370.jpg[/img]

While I was tackling that, I went through all the bug reports you lovely, lovely people have sent through the game's feedback menu (thank you! ːexoflexː) and fixed some small issues with particular cards and rare errors. Here's the list:

[list]
[*] Typos typos teh-zypos! ("only" 20 of them)
[*] Make Small Skills Boost perk and Clear Minded status roll their chances separately instead of adding them together in a confusing way
[*] Fix Bravely Helping to Fight and other +1 to total cards showing bonus beside the total, but not actually adding it to the total on rounds 2 and 3
[*] Fix Tracking the Airsquid card text to explain it only affects physical cards
[*] Confirmation dialog when forgetting or not forgetting a card while relaxing, so it's much harder to skip by that option by accident
[*] Warn in a popup the first five times any file fails to save during each play session
[*] Slightly speed up first game boot after install or update (stop unnecessarily recompiling story files)
[*] Fix controllers not closing text input popups on Steam Deck
[*] Hide resolution and quality settings on Steam Deck and stop syncing them between deck and pc, just default to what works best on that specific hardware
[/list]

- Sarah ːnyaaː

[*] fix steam deck tutorial where it says "click" so we can finally be verified

[*] fix WAKE UP font being huge sometimes

[*] fix not showing skill bonus info in bubble tooltip when net is +0

[*] fix old sol not saying interesting things about many endings

notes.title: Exocolonist Patch #2 (version 2315) changelog!
notes.content:
I Was a Teenage Exocolonist [b]Patch #2[/b], version 2315 (November 15th) is up now on Steam!

More typos and a few bugs with gear and collectibles squashed. Patch notes:

[list]
[*] fix double-equipping gear when upgrading, not being able to equip
[*] fix crystal cluster making cards unselectable in controller mode
[*] fix negative skill bonuses for statuses (mourning, injured etc)
[*] fix (hopefully) can't drag battle cards in mouse mode
[*] fix (maybe) groundhogs steam sync issue, stop saving on game exit
[*] fix gear menu card scaling in biggerMenus mode
[*] fix some job start events that weren't high priority
[*] fix a bunch of references after you preempt famine
[*] move hard-coded english strings into localization tsv for modding
[*] buncha typos
[/list]

One bug I'm hoping to (maybe) fix with this update is an issue where past memories are disappearing (characters from the main menu, endings and achievements in the gallery). This might be due to a Steam sync issue reverting the file Groundhogs.json. If you think this might still be happening to you with the new version 2315, please report it from inside the game, and if possible please also email your Steam cloud_log.txt and cloud_log previous.txt files to support@finji.co (C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\logs on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/Steam/logs on MacOS, ~/.local/share/Steam/logs on Linux).

Another issue I haven't been able to track down is fast-disappearing tooltips. They're supposed to stick around under your mouse, not disappear after a second! If this is happening to you (especially if you can figure out why!) please report it from inside the game.

Thank you for all your help!
- Sarah ːnyaaː

notes.title: Exocolonist in the IndieCade 2022 showcase!
notes.content:
[b]I Was a Teenage Exocolonist[/b] was the winner of the 2020 IndieCade award for Procedural Design (now called Systemic Design). Now that our game is all grown up and released, it'll be featured with other IndieCade alumni games as well as this year's nominees in a special Steam festival from November 4 - 11 2022.

:r3fuel: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/5419830/sale/indiecade2022]Visit the Steam festival page here[/url] :r3fuel:

IndieCade is a special show for Northway Games because we used to drive down to LA for it back in the early dawn of indie games (all the way back in 2010 when I was making Flash games), and I've helped judge the awards off and on in years since. They often feature games which push the boundaries of what a game can be, from massive meat-space events to interactive art exhibits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/efdeb66379354da8e5cfef03d5d4afd1076dd7a5.png[/img]

This year's IndieCade festival will be online, with an awards ceremony on Steam and Twitch on Saturday, November 5th at 11:00am PDT. I'll be watching! During the 2020 ceremony I was so convinced we weren't going to win that I was in the middle of making lunch when Exocolonist was announced as the winner. I had to do a mad dash to setup a webcam and give an acceptance speech. :nyaa:

The Exocolonist demo will be up from November 4 - 11, and we'll be re-streaming some of this year's interviews and developer playthroughs on the Steam page.

- Sarah :eyebug:

notes.title: I Was a Teenage Exocolonist is out!
notes.content:
I Was a Teenage Exocolonist is officially released today! I started development almost exactly five years ago, and wowowow has the game ever grown up since then!

[previewyoutube=oRRanzUQ0Vw;full][/previewyoutube]

I'd like to take a moment to thank everyone who supported Exocolonist and helped create it. Artists Meilee Chao, Eduardo Vargas, Sarah Webb, Leanne Roed, Sarah Roland, Diego De la Rocha, and our hundred card artsits for making the game so breathtakingly beautiful. Narrative designer Lindsay Ishihiro for making us laugh, cry, and fall in love with their moving prose. Gord, Em and others from A Shell in the Pit Audio, and all of our incredible musicians, for adding another dimension of wonder and beauty to the game.

Thanks to my husband Colin Northway for helping with tricky algorithms and game balancing, and for a tremendous amount of emotional support, idea-bouncing and code checks over the last five years.

Thanks to our publishers Finji, our QA and porting teams, and a very special thank you virtual hug to our incredible beta testers and all of our fans for your support and encouragement. And to my dad, who has logged hundreds of hours living life after life on the planet Vertumna.

Thank you, friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/3c25fc946b0591a945b5c8c8e85f7ccde288eacc.gif[/img]

Okay enough mushy stuff, it's release day! Time to get in there and decide what sort of Teenage Exocolonist you'll be.

Vertumna awaits!

- Sarah ːnyaaː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/8d8c81325b30fe5d015d480c956e15240ec60546.gif[/img]

notes.title: The Exocolonist Soundtrack is out!
notes.content:
Featuring artists C418, scntfc, A Shell in the Pit, Jogging House and many more! Our soundtrack blends beautiful acoustic instruments with ambient synth vibes for a style that is uniquely Vertumnan.

For the full artist list and to hear how it all came together, check out my [url=https://northwaygames.com/exocolonist-music/]Dev blog post[/url] about it.

Whether you're exploring a new planet, testing your mettle in card challenges, or dealing with the awkwardness of growing up while remembering past lives, this is your music.

[previewyoutube=6bD1YOtFNlY;full][/previewyoutube]

The Soundtrack is now  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2120490/I_Was_a_Teenage_Exocolonist_Soundtrack_and_Artbook/]available here on Steam[/url]. It includes both MP3 and high-quality FLAC audio files, and comes bundled with the official PDF artbook for the game!

So you can feast your eyes and ears while you wait. But it won't be long! Exocolonist is coming out in just a few days on Thursday August 25th!

- Sarah ːnyaaː

notes.title: One week until release (new trailer!)
notes.content:
On Thursday August 25th at 10am PT we'll finally loose our arrow into the world, piercing the hearts of narrative rpg fans as they live (and re-live) their teenage years on the planet Vertumna.

[previewyoutube=oRRanzUQ0Vw;full][/previewyoutube]

Our new launch trailer features beautiful rock-ballad "The Child You Were" by [url=http://francesaravel.com]Frances Aravel[/url], and powerful imagery from emotional moments in the game. I'm not crying, you're crying. 

Our sound designer Em Halberstadt from [url=https://ashellinthepit.com/]A Shell in the Pit Audio[/url] created it with help from Emily Liles and friends from Finji.

I'm as nervous as a hopeye about the upcoming launch!! I hope you're excited to play I Was a Teenage Exocolonist soooooooooon. 

- Sarah ːnyaaː

notes.title: Two weeks to launch (new art!)
notes.content:
Today we're unveiling our beautiful new key art by Meilee Chao. It shows off the more mature side of I Was a Teenage Exocolonist, including older versions of all the teen characters and a mysterious Sol (our name for the player character) looking like some kind of sorcerous card-o-mancer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/1c15f72a6d0af0e96719d153167a0b4edacf7ec2.jpg[/img]

Mei's older illustrations will still be in rotation on storefronts, including our beta box art showcasing a younger more innocent Sol in the natural world of Vertumna:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/6bd2913fb4ce16409a6edb8cb9bec681d120b15c.png[/img]

With exactly two weeks until release, we're thinking hard about how best to describe our narrative-rpg-deckbuilder-lifesim to the world. We've posted new screenshots and new text on our store page, and I've been practicing my elevator pitches in press interviews.

With such a unique cross-genre game that is both delicately beautiful and at times filled with viscous angst, it's been a challenge! I wonder if those of you who played the demo will be surprised with where the game goes after the first year? Only two more weeks to find out!

- Sarah ːnyaaː

notes.title: Chat with the Dev!
notes.content:
I Was a Teenage Exocolonist Developer - and I still am. A dev, that is, not a teenager. Nope, I am a (mostly) developed human adult working on a card-battling life sim about growing up on an alien planet.

Digging the demo? Have any questions about the game? I'll be around on Friday (3pm pst) this and every week for a developer update. It's the best way to get in touch with me and the rest of the team. Join us on the Finji discord:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/finji]https://discord.com/invite/finji[/url]

- Sarah

notes.title: Joining forces with Finji!
notes.content:
Big news: we are teaming up with our friends at Finji to bring I Was a Teenage Exocolonist to you!

[b]To celebrate, the Exocolonist 2020 demo will be available again until the end of November.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/6d21e331b95b43be83153a312ecd286d963716da.png[/img]

Yes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/finji]THAT Finji[/url], the people who brought you Night in the Woods, Overland, Wilmot's Warehouse, FEIST, Panoramical, Canabalt and Capsule. And soon Chicory, TUNIC, and [b]I Was a Teenage Exocolonist[/b]!

We are incredibly stoked by our partnership with Bekah, Adam, and the rest of the Finji team. I’ve known them for many years and can’t emphasize enough how much respect I have for Finji as publishers, designers, and leaders in our industry. Northway Games has always self-published until now, but I Was a Teenage Exocolonist is our biggest game yet, and merits this opportunity to reach a wider audience with Finji leading the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/f6b7541f94e884684e3ba93d2e4e9509a512b0bf.png[/img]

Happy Thanksgiving to Americans, and happy Exocolonist-Finji day to everyone.

- Sarah and the Exo team
